indigo-voltage.$description: Indigo Voltage — Primary action buttons, active nav states, accent borders, heading highlights — the sole chromatic brand color, making every interactive element unmistakable; Primary CTA button fill — the only gradient in the system, flowing from cyan to indigo vertically

mint-whisper.$description: Mint Whisper — Signature section surface — replaces gray for feature panels, product wrappers, and comparison cards; a soft teal that reads as a colored canvas rather than a colored card; Radial hero wash — cyan blooming into neutral gray for ambient atmosphere on showcase sections

cyan-pulse.$description: Cyan Pulse — Gradient origin point and link glow shadow; appears only inside the cyan→indigo button gradient and the radial brand wash

cyan-mist.$description: Cyan Mist — Soft cyan used as a link-focus glow ring; bridges Mint Whisper and the gradient endpoints

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icons, hairline borders, and image outlines — used at high frequency for structural edges rather than fills

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on indigo fills

fog-veil.$description: Fog Veil — Secondary card and section surface — the next step up from pure white before reaching Mint Whisper

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Muted borders and dividers; structural edges that need to be visible but never assertive

graphite-depth.$description: Graphite Depth — Deep accent for headings and section frames where pure black would feel too sharp

steel-caption.$description: Steel Caption — Body helper text, link base color, icon fills, and secondary metadata — the de facto mid-neutral for prose

haze-card.$description: Haze Card — Tertiary card surface for grouped content blocks and inner panels

silka-semibold.$description: Silka SemiBold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

hk-sentiments.$description: Display and section headings — a bold serif-adjacent sans that carries the voice of headlines, tightened by negative tracking

silka.$description: All UI text, body copy, button labels, and inline links — a neutral geometric sans for the functional layer

silka-italic.$description: Accent italic for emphasized phrases inside body copy

system-ui-sans-serif.$description: Micro UI text — tag labels, fine print, timestamp-style metadata

silka-regular.$description: Silka Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

silka-medium-italic.$description: Silka Medium Italic — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
